d: Job Title: Senior Generator Technician - TS/SCI
Job Category: Engineering and Technical Support
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%
CACI is seeking a Sr. Generator Technician to support our mission critical program in Kuwait.

As the selected Senior Generator Technician, you will, in part, perform preventative maintenance, load bank, field diagnosis and repairs on 50kW ~ 2500kW stand alone and paralleling generators and automatic transfer switches. You will also be responsible for the diagnosis and repair of related electrical components: paralleling switchgear, automatic transfer switches, distribution gear, transformers, service panels, voltage regulators, troubleshooting AC and DC circuits.
q: Bachelors Degree plus 3 years experience or High School Diploma or equivalent and a power generation certification with a 10 years of experience in power generation operations; or 12 years’ Military experience in power generation operations.
Technical understanding of power generation operation and maintenance, certification from power generation manufacturer preferred.
Knowledge of document and report writing.
Knowledge of safe work practices and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Knowledge of lockout and tag out procedures.
Ability to effectively communicate, speak and write.
US Citizen with an active TS/SCI clearance is required.
